exposure: bilateral electro-acupuncture at Hua Tuo Jia Ji and Sanyinjiao
cohort: The study reviewed literature on parturients, including those with a history of substance abuse, undergoing labor.
finding: Bilateral electro-acupuncture significantly reduces active phase labor length, visual analog scale pain scores, and the Cesarean delivery rate compared to no-analgesia controls.
mod_finding: Electro-acupuncture was found to reduce the Cesarean delivery rate.
